response.original_title: AJPW New Year Giant Series 1998 Day 15
response.overview: All Japan Pro Wrestling's (AJPW) New Year Giant Series 1998 Day 15 took place on January 26, 1998, at the Osaka Prefectural Gymnasium in Osaka, Japan. The legendary main event featured Mitsuharu Misawa successfully defending the Triple Crown Heavyweight Championship against Jun Akiyama.
